levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: two separate isnads carry the same story: the first ends at معمر (the text closes it with a full stop), the second runs to Abu Sufyan, who narrates the story in the first person
«من فيه إلى في» is an idiom («directly from his mouth to mine»), not a name
«قال الزهري فدعا هرقل» is the transmitter's continuation of the story, not a new isnad
